purpose: Continue the Safari canvas discovery with OCR-stable single-word UI labels while preserving exact-text matching. Prove a real Safari semantic gap, exact local Vision resolution, real Computer Control click delivery and an independent visual postcondition before any built-in Safari contract is promoted.
requiredClaims: If Safari is already running, execution is blocked before immutable evidence is created.
The existing real Safari application Provider and real Safari process/bundle are used.
The page is loopback-only and the visible target is rendered only into HTML canvas with no accessible fallback text.
The test-owned visual target is the single UI-like word PROCEED and the independent postcondition is FINISHED, rendered at large high-contrast size for OCR stability.
P3A remains exact-text-single-match; no fuzzy, normalized or approximate product matching is introduced.
The initial local Vision observation resolves exactly one PROCEED target and confirms FINISHED is absent.
A fresh Safari semantic snapshot cannot resolve PROCEED and yields structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
Real Computer Control delivery returns CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.
Only a fresh independent post-action Vision observation containing exactly FINISHED and no PROCEED may produce VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
No built-in Safari visual-fallback contract exists or is created by this discovery.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payload strings and coordinates are not persisted or printed; diagnostics are limited to state, reason, match count and observation count.
Pointer, Safari, loopback server, runtime/cache and temporary resources are cleaned up and product trees remain clean.
nonClaims: P6B does not validate generic Safari or arbitrary web automation.
P6B does not ship a Safari visual-fallback caller contract.
P6B does not broaden matching policy, gestures, displays or provider capabilities.
P6B does not alter P1-P5, P6A or Computer Control runtime contracts.
P6B does not claim external-network browser automation.

s01.reason: PoC oracle incorrectly treated successful unresolved target-resolution processing as presence of the postcondition.

s02.reason: Correct oracle reached the visual boundary but the synthetic multi-token canvas target produced no exact Vision match.

s03.reason: Vision observed the frame with 49 text observations but still returned NO_EXACT_TEXT_MATCH for the multi-token target; no click was performed.

evidencePolicy.safariUserState: Preflight blocks before session creation if Safari is running; the physical test repeats the guard for races.
evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s04 unchanged, diagnose the exact remaining boundary and create s05 only after a forward-only test or product change justified by evidence.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned canvas content is used. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and out of session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P6C evidence-backed bounded caller-contract integration for the discovered Safari canvas case
